Messages.Author: Snoop
Messages.Body:
What happen when the vampire targetted by the Rack is burned ? Could the
meth chose another vamp ? is the Rack burned ? or is it considered
uncontrolled and must be stolen to target a vamp again ( and if yes, could
the controlling meth of the burned dude do it ?)

Can i play a Blood of Acid before an add strike ? (even if i don't have an
additionnal strike ?)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Snoop" <p_st...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> What happen when the vampire targetted by the Rack is
> burned ? Could the meth chose another vamp ? is the Rack
> burned ? or is it considered uncontrolled and must be
> stolen to target a vamp again ( and if yes, could the
> controlling meth of the burned dude do it ?)

Respectively:
Nothing. No. No. It is not "uncontrolled", but merely
has no "target". It must be stolen to be re-targetted.
The controller of the Rack cannot steal it.

> Can i play a Blood of Acid before an add strike ? (even
> if i don't have an additionnal strike ?)

No. Like the similarly-templated Immortal Grapple, it
can only be played between the range determination and
the initial strike selection phase. It cannot be played
after the initial strike resolution of a round.
